title: Data Transfer
desc: Export and import data configurations for events, categories, cards, and more.

export.title: Export Configuration
export.desc: Customize columns, order, aliases, and formats for exporting data.
export.pleaseSelectOrAddSetting: Please select a module or add a new configuration.
export.previewNoConfig: Please select a configuration to preview
export.autoAddActionColumnDesc: This will automatically include an action column for processing.

import.title: Import Configuration
import.desc: Define import columns, data range, ignored fields, and action column support.

upload.title: Upload Your File
upload.desc: Drag & drop a CSV or Excel file, or click to browse. We will auto-detect headers and suggest settings.

items.format: Supports Excel formats (XLSX, XLS, CSV, TSV) with a maximum file size of 10MB.
items.preview: A preview of the first 10 rows will be displayed after a successful upload.
items.headerSelect: Select a row to designate it as the Header row.
items.flowMapping: The selected header row will be used for column mapping in the next step.
items.flowRange: The data range in subsequent steps will automatically start from this header row onwards.

mapping.title: Map Columns
mapping.desc: Match columns from your uploaded file to the target fields of the module.

items.display: System fields are on the left, and your file's header fields are on the right.
items.interaction: Drag fields from the left column and drop them onto the matching fields on the right.
items.autoMatch: The 'Apply Auto-match' button helps link fields with similar names automatically.
items.warning: Note: Auto-matching may not be 100% accurate; please review all mappings before proceeding.

range.title: Select Data Range
range.desc: Click and drag on the grid to select the actual data area (exclude headers, footers, or irrelevant rows).
range.actionDesc: Adds an _action column to support create/update/delete/skip operations during import.
range.autoScaleYDesc: Auto-detect the last row of data in the file
range.actionColumnDesc: If not checked, the application will treat it (_action) as a normal column (which may cause errors)

items.drag: Left-click and drag to select the data area.
items.rightClick: Right-click to set range or 'Apply with Auto-Scale' (requires 2 points on the same row).
items.pan: Hold Space key to pan around the canvas smoothly.
items.format: Enter coordinates in Excel format (e.g., A2, G7).
items.empty: Leaving coordinates empty will scan the entire file; 'Auto set to last row' must be enabled.

validate.title: Validation Summary
validate.desc: Review potential issues before saving the configuration.
validate.noIssues: No validation issues found. Ready to save.
validate.missingRequired: Some required fields are missing data in rows
validate.formatMismatch: Data format mismatch detected in some cells

messages.rangeCannotBeEqual: Start and end range cannot be the same
messages.pairsMustMatch: Fill both Start/End fields or leave both empty
messages.mustBeSameRow: Data range must be in the same row
messages.mustEnableAutoScaleForAll: This option must be enabled for all columns
messages.noMappingDesc: You must map at least one column to a field, otherwise the import will fail.
messages.rangeAllWarnDesc:
Please ensure the input file follows the standard format.
Scanning cells with custom formatting may lead to unexpected processing errors
messages.proceedWithWarning: Some warnings detected. Save and continue anyway?

import.autoAddActionDesc: Include an _action column for import instructions (create/update/delete/skip).

placeholder.noConfigSelectedDesc: Please select an Import Configuration to enable and customize related settings
